Here is the revised email, adjusted to be professional, constructive, and focused on performance improvement rather than personal attack:

Subject: Follow-up on Project Submission Deadline

Hi [Name],

I noticed that the project submission was missed. This is the second time recently that deadlines have not been met, and I want to understand if there are any obstacles preventing you from staying on track.

Let’s schedule a brief meeting to discuss your current workload and any support you might need to ensure we meet future deadlines. My goal is to help you succeed here, so please come prepared to share your perspective on what’s causing these delays.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
